stem: No idea really cant remember the blood results. Could be a traumatic tap, but there should be 400-500 RBC for every extra 1 WBC and 1000 RBC for every extra 0.01g/L protein. (RCH CSF guidelines). Viral meningitis is also possible.

options.text: 13y old aboriginal girl with respiratory distress, cough, chest pain, unwell. CXR shows bilateral infiltrates through all lobes. What is the most likely causative organism?
Streptococcus pneumonia* not sure but I think it is strep penumoniae since aboriginals have the highest rates of invasive pneumococcal disease in the world
